nodes.description: Constructor of UniswapExchange; sets name, symbol, totalSupply, assigns owner = msg.sender and pre-approves UNI router.
Public payable transfer; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom; checks allowance, calls ensure(), mutates balances and _onSaleNum without SafeMath.
Internal whitelist check; allows owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable approve; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal sale restriction logic using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address.
Owner-only initializer for sale parameters; multiplies token/maxToken by 10**decimals.
Owner-only batch distribution; computes total = _value * _tos.length and credits recipients in a loop.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256.
Library helper checking extcodehash to determine whether an address is a contract.
Private library function performing a low-level call to a token address and decoding optional return data.
Private owner address; gate for delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of holder balances.
Public nested mapping of allowances.
Private mapping counting per-address sale occurrences.
Private mapping of addresses allowed to sell.
Private minimum sale amount boundary.
Private maximum sale amount boundary.
Private max number of sales per address.
Whitelisted trade address bypassing sale conditions.
Public constant decimals = 18.
Public total token supply.
Caller-supplied address used for authorization, ownership and balance accounting in multiple entry points.
Arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-controlled address inside delegate().
Low-level address(token).call(data) in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length and unchecked balance additions in batchSend.
Unchecked balance/allowance subtraction and addition in transferFrom (Solidity 0.5.17, no SafeMath).
Recipient address parameter (transfer/transferFrom).
Amount parameter (transfer/transferFrom).
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.
Target address of delegatecall in delegate.
Calldata bytes passed to delegatecall in delegate.
Sale-count limit parameter of init.
Minimum sale amount parameter of init, scaled by decimals.
Maximum sale amount parameter of init, scaled by decimals.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Locally computed Uniswap pair address in ensure.
Loop index in batchSend.

edges.reason: transfer() delegates its logic to transferFrom().
transferFrom() requires the ensure() whitelist/sale check to pass.
ensure() enforces condition() for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure() computes the Uniswap pair via pairFor().
msg.sender determines allowance consumption and is the implicit _from in transfer().
approve() writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate() authorizes using require(msg.sender == owner).
init() authorizes using require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() authorizes using require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() authorizes using require(msg.sender == owner).
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender and grants total supply.
owner state variable gates the delegate() call.
owner address bypasses ensure() restrictions.
_value is subtracted/added to balances and counted in sale limits without SafeMath.
_from is the source of funds and allowance check in transferFrom().
_to receives the transferred balance in transferFrom().
balanceOf mapping is read and mutated with unchecked arithmetic.
allowance mapping is checked and decremented in transferFrom().
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented in transferFrom().
_spender is the allowance key written in approve().
tradeAddress is compared against _from in ensure().
canSale[_from] short-circuits ensure() checks.
_saleNum bounds _onSaleNum in condition().
_minSale lower-bounds the sale value in condition().
_maxSale upper-bounds the sale value in condition().
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared to _saleNum in condition().
_value is range-checked against _minSale/_maxSale boundaries.
saleNum parameter sets _saleNum in init().
token parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals to set _minSale.
maxToken parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals to set _maxSale.
decimals scales token and maxToken in init().
init() writes _minSale with an unchecked multiplication.
init() writes _maxSale with an unchecked multiplication.
init() writes _saleNum.
_tos array supplies recipients in batchSend().
_value multiplied by _tos.length and credited to recipients without SafeMath.
balanceOf is read and mutated with unchecked arithmetic in batchSend().
addr parameter is written to tradeAddress.
Attacker-controlled target a is used as the delegatecall destination.
Attacker-controlled calldata b is forwarded to delegatecall.
Parameter a becomes the callee of an arbitrary delegatecall, enabling state-hijacking/reentrancy.
delegate() performs the unsafe delegatecall operation.
batchSend() executes unchecked multiplication and balance credit loop.
transferFrom() executes unchecked balance arithmetic.
balanceOf values flow into unchecked subtraction/addition in transferFrom().
callOptionalReturn() performs a low-level call to an arbitrary token contract.
callOptionalReturn() verifies the target is a contract via Address.isContract().
totalSupply is computed in the constructor from _supply * 10**decimals.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only feeds the transferFrom() entry point, so it collapses into that core function.
Amount parameter flows directly into unchecked balance arithmetic inside transferFrom().
Source address parameter is consumed by allowance/balance logic within transferFrom().
Spender parameter is only used as the allowance key in approve().
Recipient array parameter is iterated only inside batchSend().
Address parameter is assigned directly to tradeAddress in setTradeAddress().
Delegatecall target parameter is the callee of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Calldata parameter is forwarded to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Sale-count parameter is stored into _saleNum inside init().
Minimum amount parameter is scaled and stored into _minSale inside init().
Maximum amount parameter is scaled and stored into _maxSale inside init().
Local total is the result of the unchecked multiplication that defines the unsafe arithmetic.
Locally computed pair address is only compared against _from within ensure().
Loop counter is confined to the batchSend() distribution loop.
